name: Life Of Christ
overview: The Life of Christ reveals the pathway to eternal life through faith in Jesus, God's only begotten Son, who was given out of divine love for the world. Believing in Him transitions a person from death to life, as He declares Himself the exclusive way to the Father and the source of truth and life. The gift of eternal life contrasts with the wages of sin, emphasizing that it is received through Jesus Christ our Lord. This life is not merely physical existence but a spiritual union with Christ, who lives within believers by faith, demonstrating His sacrificial love.
